purpose: Prospectively complete operational semantics left underspecified by Step7 without changing its scientific design.

scheduler.warmup_definition: Linear multiplier from 1/warmup_updates through 1.0 across the first epoch optimizer updates.
scheduler.cosine_definition: After warmup, cosine decay from each parameter group's frozen base LR to 0.0 at the final planned optimizer update of max_epochs.

gradient_accumulation.rule: Backpropagate each microbatch mean loss multiplied by its actual sample count; at each accumulation boundary unscale AMP gradients, divide gradients by the accumulated sample count, clip global norm to 1.0, then optimizer step.
gradient_accumulation.rationale: Preserves a true sample mean for the final partial accumulation window.

early_stopping.rule: Track lexicographic improvement from epoch 1; an improvement resets the no-improvement counter. Do not stop before 5 completed epochs. At or after epoch 5, stop when 4 consecutive completed epochs have produced no lexicographic improvement.

metrics.macro_f1: binary two-class macro mean with zero division mapped to 0
metrics.balanced_accuracy: mean of per-class recalls with both classes required by frozen population
metrics.auroc: deterministic rank-based AUROC with average ranks for ties

prohibitions: no sample dropping to make accumulation divisible
